title: Blackrock Encampment
order_note: Sorted by recording id: C (cinematics), M (in-engine cutscenes), T (gameplay transmissions); unit barks follow their trigger group. Interleaving of C/M/T is not confirmed.

lines.scene: Dialogues.Transmissions Dialogue 01 Orcs Stain On These Lands
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Orcs. They’ve been a stain on these lands for years.

lines.scene: Dialogues.Transmissions Dialogue 01 Orcs Stain On These Lands
lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Not all of them. But the Blackrock clan are known for their brutal raiders.

lines.scene: Dialogues.Transmissions Dialogue 01 Orcs Stain On These Lands
lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then let’s discourage them from raiding the Forsaken.

lines.scene: Dialogues.Transmissions Dialogue 02 The Deed Is Done
lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: The deed is done. Perhaps the other orcs will heed the warning.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Leonid, you said not all orcs threaten these lands. Have you met others?

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Yes, in the Argent Dawn. I've heard rumors of a young warchief who led many of the orcs across the sea.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: It is said he is forming a "new Horde" that values strength and honor.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I’ll believe that when I see it.
